description: Troubleshooting procedure for faults during robotic placement of an insert onto a positioned part.

box_1.text: Does the product meet quality assurance team product specifications?

box_2.text: Identify and note the defect type on the non conforming part (e.g. a dent on the part surface) before proceeding.

box_3.text: Remove the non conforming parts and reload with a product batch that meets quality assurance team specifications.

box_4.text: Is picking up part from supply conveyor correct?

box_5.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check by jogging whether the part pickup from the supply conveyor is correct and whether the part is correctly aligned under the vacuum head. 2. Check whether the assembly robot produces excessive retries during pickup.

box_8.text: Verify that the part is mounted centred and straight from the indexing table, all actuators have reached their end positions, and all part lifters are at equal height.

box_12.text: Complete the following steps: 1. Refer to the vacuum part present detection diagnostic. 2. Check whether the correct vacuum pressure value is reached.

box_13.text: Refer to the vacuum pressure value check for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_14.text: Refer to the vacuum pressure value check for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_17.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the assembly robot axis/axes for contamination. 2. Check the centering sleeve and vacuum tube for contamination.

box_18.text: Clean the contaminated assembly robot axis, centering sleeve, and vacuum tube.

box_20.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check proximity sensor and cabling. 2. Check assembly robot for cable breaks. 3. Check the force sensor for electrical defects.

box_21.text: Replace the defective component identified in the inspection (proximity sensor, cabling, or force sensor).

box_23.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check wear on the vacuum tube. 2. Check wear on the actuator centering sleeve. 3. Check the assembly robot axes for wear. 4. Check smooth movement of the centering sleeve relative to the vacuum tube (by disconnecting the actuator).

box_24.text: Replace the worn components identified in the inspection (vacuum tube, centering sleeve, and/or assembly robot axes).

box_25.text: Is the blow off flow (+ duration) correct?

box_27.text: Refer to the blow off flow and duration check for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_28.text: Refer to the blow off flow and duration check for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_29.text: Resolve clamping issue and replace hose if damaged.

box_30.text: Is the retracted position of the centering sleeve relative to the vacuum tube correct?

box_31.text: Refer to the centering sleeve height specification for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_32.text: Refer to the centering sleeve height specification for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_33.text: Refer to the centering sleeve height specification for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_34.text: Adjust the retracted position of the centering sleeve to match the specification, or replace the centering sleeve assembly if the correct position cannot be achieved.

box_35.text: Is the (press down) height of the vacuum tube relative to 4x part fixture correct?

box_36.text: Refer to the assembly process specification for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_37.text: Refer to the assembly process specification for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_38.text: Refer to the assembly process specification for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_39.text: Adjust the press down height of the vacuum tube relative to the part fixture to match the specification, or replace the vacuum tube assembly if the correct height cannot be achieved.

box_40.text: Is the force sensor working correctly?

box_41.text: Refer to the pre pressure force range specification for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_42.text: Refer to the pre pressure force range specification for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_43.text: Refer to the pre pressure force range specification for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_44.text: Force sensor calibration procedure for insert placement

box_45.text: Is the XY placement position of the assembly robot correct?

box_46.text: Refer to the part alignment specification for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_47.text: Refer to the part alignment specification for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_48.text: Refer to the part alignment specification for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_49.text: Set the Z height of the assembly robot to the value specified in the variant specific assembly process specification.

box_51.text: Perform the assembly robot XY calibration procedure to correct the insert placement position on the part fixture.

box_52.text: Verify that the part is lightly pressed into the insert and is seated without looseness or tilt.

box_53.text: Placing part on insert is correct

box_54.text: Refer to the vacuum pressure value check for variant A machines (small format parts), standard vacuum pressure applies; use the vacuum part present detection diagnostic only, no variant specific pressure specification is required for small format parts.

box_55.text: Refer to the blow off flow and duration check for variant A machines (small format parts), standard blow off parameters apply; use the general pneumatic flow measurement procedure only, no variant specific blow off calibration is required for small format parts.
